title: Gummi World Renews USDA Organic Certification, Accelerates Momentum Under Parent Company Intiva Health
text:
Gummi World Renews USDA Organic Certification, Accelerates Momentum Under Parent Company Intiva Health By: PRUnderground August 27, 2025 at 23:26 PM EDT As Gummi World renews its USDA Organic certification, the company doubles down on its mission to drive growth, trust, and innovation in the fast-evolving supplement market.
(PRUnderground) August 27th, 2025
Gummi World, a subsidiary of parent company Intiva Health, recently announced the renewal of its USDA Organic certification, reinforcing a commitment to quality and transparency that continues to resonate with buyers, consumers, and investors alike. The milestone adds to a growing list of third-party validations for the company, which remains the first and only manufacturer of over-the-counter (OTC) compliant gummies.
This latest progress reflects a broader push inside the Intiva Health portfolio, where strategic investments are being made to raise compliance standards, expand manufacturing capabilities, and create real-world value for brands at every stage of growth.
Certifications That Back Up the Promise
At Gummi World, certifications are not just achievements to list. They are day-to-day disciplines that shape how the company operates.
“Renewing USDA Organic isn’t just about keeping a stamp on our label. It’s about maintaining the systems and safeguards that earn trust from some of the most sophisticated brands in the world,” said Alexander C. Candelario, CEO and Chairman of Intiva Health. “When a partner walks through our facility, they’re not just seeing clean floors and batch records. They’re seeing a team that understands what’s at stake in every formula, every audit, every shipment.”
In addition to USDA Organic and its exclusive OTC gummy status, Gummi World maintains one of the most comprehensive certification portfolios in the industry. These include Where Food Comes From, NSF/ANSI 455-2 cGMP, NSF Certified for Sport®, NSF Health Sciences Certification Program (HSCPC), NSF/ANSI 455-4 OTC Drug Manufacturing, and NSF Costco Product Certification. The company is also Non-GMO Project Verified, GFCO Gluten-Free Certified, USP Certified, and holds certifications from both FSPCA and the Gluten-Free Certification Program.
These third-party validations cover everything from ingredient sourcing and production controls to retailer-specific standards. For buyers and brand leaders, they serve as a clear signal that Gummi World is equipped to meet the complex compliance demands of today’s competitive supplement market.
Training That Translates to Execution
Earlier this year, every member of the Gummi World team completed a five-day training focused on GMP rigor, documentation best practices, and operational discipline. The program was built to go beyond compliance theory and translate directly into the floor-level decisions that impact product quality.
“When we talk about quality culture, this is what we mean,” said Candelario. “We’re not interested in just passing audits. We want our teams to instinctively do the right thing, whether someone’s watching or not. That’s the kind of mindset that keeps products moving, keeps customers confident, and keeps brands coming back.”
Driven by Intiva Health’s Strategic Platform
As a portfolio company of Intiva Health, Gummi World benefits from both investment and alignment. Intiva’s leadership continues to prioritize companies that operate with clinical precision and long-term resilience in highly regulated spaces.
“At Gummi World, we’re not just another manufacturer; we’re a catalyst for the next era of innovation. We’ve built a foundation that lets brands grow fearlessly, knowing we’re right there with them every step of the way,” added Candelario. “From our cutting-edge certifications to our agile approach, we’ve created an environment where consistency and creativity can thrive together. That’s why you’re seeing increased demand, stronger partnerships, and growing attention from global brands that need a reliable manufacturing partner.”
Expansion to Meet Market Demand
Gummi World recently expanded into capsule manufacturing to better serve its growing customer base. The move enables brands to consolidate their production partners and bring multi-format product lines to market faster and more efficiently.
“We’re built for speed, but never at the expense of standards,” said Candelario. “Our partners know they can come to us with a tight timeline or a complex regulatory ask, and we’ll deliver without cutting corners. That balance of creativity and control is what sets us apart.”
Why It Matters and What to Do Next
If you’re looking for a manufacturing partner that meets the highest standards without slowing you down, Gummi World delivers the structure, speed, and support to help you grow. With industry-first designations, full-scale manufacturing across gummies and capsules, and the backing of Intiva Health, the company is ready to help you confidently scale.
Launch USDA Organic-certified and Non-GMO Project Verified products with full traceability Leverage exclusive OTC gummy manufacturing capabilities Collaborate with a team trained in GMP rigor and audit readiness Simplify multi-format development with gummies and capsules under one roof Partner with an organization backed by Intiva Health’s operational strength and long-term investment strategy To schedule a facility tour, request a quote, or learn more, visit gummiworld.com .
About Gummi World
Intiva Health is revolutionizing the health of healthcare through technology, compliance, and wellness innovation. As the parent company of Incredable, Gummi World, and Nova Vita Wellness Centers, Intiva Health delivers cutting-edge solutions across multiple sectors. Incredable streamlines provider credentialing and compliance with an industry-leading digital platform. Gummi World, the most certified nutraceutical manufacturer in the industry, ensures unmatched quality and safety in custom gummy and supplement production. Nova Vita Wellness Centers provide advanced regenerative health therapies, including IV infusions, peptides, and telehealth services. Together, these companies are transforming healthcare by improving efficiency, accessibility, and patient outcomes.
